metadata.title: That One Kill That Should’ve Totally Missed But Valorant Said ‘Nah, You’re Good’
metadata.description:
When you’re aiming for the floor but the enemy gets the invite.
How did this even land? Valorant logic is wild.
Watch me accidentally make a kill and question my life choices.

Hit like if this has ever happened to you!

Tell me your most accidental kill in the comments!

#valorant #gamingclips #funnygaming #luckykill #shorts
